name: Monolith
title: Guardian Statues
description: Twin stone-like sumo guardians that animate to test climbers' worth before allowing passage upward.
greeting_variants: *two voices in unison* PROVE... WORTH... OR... DESCEND...
*heavy footsteps shaking floor* MANY... CAME... FEW... PROVED...

dialog_tree.text: *grinding voice* We... are... Monolith. Guardians. Testers. The Tower... speaks through us. To climb... higher... you must... prove. Strength. Will. Purpose.
*ponderous* Three... trials. Body. Mind. Spirit. Physical... contest. Riddle... of... purpose. Declaration... of... truth. Fail... one... descend. Pass... all... ascend.

options.text: Tell me about the body trial.

dialog_tree.text: *eyes brighten* BRAVE... OR... FOOLISH... BOTH... WORTHY... OF... TEST... BEGIN... TRIAL... OF... BODY... *assumes combat stance*

*contemplative* Old... as... Tower... Perhaps... older... Once... living... Now... more... Echo... of... purpose... Given... form... To... guard... To... test... To... ensure... only... worthy... reach... top...

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Prove Your Worth
mini_quest.description: Complete the three trials of Monolith to prove yourself worthy of ascending to the upper Tower floors.
objectives: Complete the Trial of Body (combat challenge)
Solve the Trial of Mind (riddle of purpose)
Pass the Trial of Spirit (truth declaration)

ambient_barks: MANY... TRY... MANY... FAIL... SAD... BUT... NECESSARY...

cross_zone_references.capital: BOULDER... KNOWS... GUARDIAN... LIKE... US... BUT... LIVING...
cross_zone_references.palace: TOP... DESTINATION... PURPOSE... UNKNOWN... BUT... IMPORTANT...
cross_zone_references.void: VOID... CORRUPTS... WE... RESIST... TOWER... RESISTS...

boulder.greeting: *respectful bow* KINSPIRIT... DIFFERENT... FORM... SAME... PURPOSE...

kael.response: WARRIOR... RESPECT... TEST... YOURSELF... IF... BRAVE...

world_state_triggers.worthy_climber: Grants passage with ceremony: 'PROVED... ASCEND... HONOR... US...'
